reviews_h2: What people are saying about the auto detailing

reviews.author: John L
reviews.text: Had my front windows tinted with ceramic tint. My appointment was at 9am. Dominic took me in on time ,explained everything in detail , took about 45 minutes to do the job ,and it was QUALITY WORK. My 2026 front Kia Sorento windows look Great. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Noneofyo Bizznez
reviews.text: This was a tricky job, and Michelle did great work. My seats stain easily. Even just water creates an ugly ring. And self cleaning made it look dirtier and I couldn't avoid the moisture ring around the edge. The hot water extraction breathed new life into my seats. (see before and after). It couldn't get every spot from my 2010 car, but it was a major improvement. I liked the ppl at Authentic Detailing. Dan was nice and responsive. Plus, their waiting room was super nice!

reviews.author: Tyler Endres
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Authentic Detailing when I got my car tinted. The customer service was excellent, they kept me updated throughout the entire process and sent helpful reminders so I never missed anything. Really smooth and professional experience. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Juan Esteban Pérez Arache
reviews.text: I went to add tint to my Toyota sienna 2026 xse the work was flawless, very quick and price fairly, all the staff was super friendly, respectful and knowledgeable. They got the job done in 30 minutes and give straight instructions on how to take care of the tint, I ask them to match the factory tint % and as you can see in the pictures its match perfectly.

reviews.author: Julius Brisco
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing did a wonderful job with my Chevy Suburban. The interior was my main concern after years of road trips with kids/ pets and a recent huge sugary drink spill that left some of my controls sticky but I'm elated to say that my vehicle looks like it did the day I picked it up from the dealership. I will definitely be using Authentic again in the future.

reviews.author: Marlin
reviews.text: Michele and Roshawn did and outstanding job with the tint and 8 year ceramic coat. I felt that they helped explain the pros and con with all of our options. My wife and I could not be happier with the results

reviews.author: Chris Smith
reviews.text: I'm extremely happy with the new front widow tint on my Tacoma. It matches perfectly to the existing tinted windows. Dan was very professional, and did a great job of explaining all my choices. The work was done while I waited. It looks great. Thanks to Authentic Detailing. I'll be recommending you to all my friends. I'll be back.

reviews.author: Joel Nordsving
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about the team at Authentic Detailing! Dan and his incredibly talented and meticulous crew installed ceramic window tint and paint protection film on the entire front of our car. They even took the extra time to wrap the film around the edges wherever possible to eliminate visible lines, attention to detail like that really stands out. On top of that, they fully detailed the entire vehicle, even though it wasn’t part of the original agreement. Talk about going above and beyond! It’s clear these guys genuinely care about their customers’ cars and are committed to delivering results that leave you impressed and completely satisfied. Highly recommend Authentic Detailing, true professionals who take pride in their work. Lori & Joel

reviews.author: Cotina Smith
reviews.text: I had all my windows/windshield tinted by Authentic Detailing. I was first impressed by the professionalism customer service, which is big for me. My vehicle was done and ready in a timely manner and I am completely satisfied with the results of the work done. Initially the price nearly choked me, it is worth every penny of the quality I received. I would recommend my friends and family to this company. Thank you for a great job.

reviews.author: Ray Bostanci
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Authentic Detailing from start to finish.Before calling I looked into their website and it was amazing. Scheduling was easy which I really appreciated. When I arrived, the shop itself was just as impressive-very clean, organized, and professional. You can tell they take pride in their work environment. Most importantly, the quality of the tint job was excellent. Everything came out flawless, and the attention to detail really shows. I was so satisfied with the results that I ended up bringing in my other car as well. Highly recommend them if you're looking for quality work and a smooth, professional experience.

reviews.author: Trina J
reviews.text: I only had my 2 front windows done on my SUV, but they turned out great! I am extremely satisfied! Not to mention, I was given great customer service and guidance on choosing my tint. My windows were done in about an hour and they communicated well during this process. Great prices also! Please go here for your tint needs!!!

reviews.author: Corpse Game's
reviews.text: I recently got my car’s tint done at Authentic Detailing’s new location. They did an amazing job, and everyone there was incredibly polite and knowledgeable. If you’re unsure about what tint to get, they’re more than happy to help you figure it out. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and friendly tinting service.

reviews.author: Darren Johnson
reviews.text: You guys did a fantastic job. I was able to speak with you, have an assessment made of my needs, and make an appointment quickly. The execution was flawless and the work looks great.

reviews.author: Shane Brady
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing did an amazing job tinting the windows on my 2022 Chevrolet Traillboss and on my wife’s 2023 Bronco outer banks. They were extremely fast and efficient and both vehicles look great. I highly recommend everyone to come by and get your vehicles done by them, prices are great, workmanship is amazing. Extremely happy with the way they both look. Thank you guys again

reviews.author: Erika Quinn
reviews.text: Was quoted $1400 for tinting my 2026 grand Highlander at some other place. I called Authentic Detailing and got a much better deal for half the price than the original quote. I was seen and taken care of in a timely fashion that I also had my sons car my tinted the very next day. 10 out of 10 would recommend. Great quality work.

reviews.author: Jonathan Barber
reviews.text: Found these guys be freak accident and I couldn't be happier. They def went above and beyond working the paint on my 18yo Rover and it almost looks brand new again. I've lived in Raleigh for almost 5 years and haven't found anyone competent to tackle this job but after hanging out in there a while getting my tint done I approached Dan about their paint correction. I knew they knew what was up and I'm glad I had that feeling because now my Rover looks amazing again. These guys are the real deal so def go see Dan to help polish your gem. Thanks to everyone there that pitched in! 10 stars!

reviews.author: Trever Broussard
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing did a great job teaching me how to tint. They were patient, knowledgeable, and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. I learned a lot and felt more confident by the end. Definitely recommend them to anyone wanting to learn window tinting.

reviews.author: Melissa Bilyeu
reviews.text: I called Dan and his team about detailing and cleaning my car to give to my son for college. They did a tremendous job! Removed a lot of beach sand, pet hair, and probably a few withered French fries. The car looks and smells brand new! Great service, skill, and value for a full, professional detail.

reviews.author: Aj Venturella
reviews.text: 10/10. The best Car detailing and tint place around. Customer service is amazing. My car looks brand new and they definitely had there work cut out for them how dirty it was. I highly recommend here and for the price too you can't beat it. I will definitely always be going back.

reviews.author: Jennifer Somerville
reviews.text: OMG! My husband’s Mustang Bullitt looks amazing after they put the carbon window tint, the 8-year ceramic coating, and the front clip ppf. We are so pleased with Dan and his team my Lexus is next. The professionalism and customer service is as top notch as their work.

reviews.author: Mel & Sherry May
reviews.text: Dan & staff did a fantastic job on my new 2023 Chevrolet Silverado ZR2! They had their work cut out on the paint correction due to the dealership running it through a brush car wash. They got aloof the scratches out & ceramic coated the truck, windows & wheels. It looks so good. Dan explained everything in detail from start to care instructions moving forward to help the finish last. Thanks Dan!

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: I recently had my 2017 Ford Expedition detailed by Dan and the crew at Authentic Detailing, and I couldn't be happier with the results. My vehicle came in with significant concerns about paint wear and tear, but it came out looking absolutely fantastic. The windows are now crystal clear and shiny, just like new. The ceramic finish they applied was well worth it, giving my car a brilliant, glossy reflection that exceeded my expectations. Dan and his team demonstrated exceptional skill and attention to detail, transforming my vehicle's appearance completely. I highly recommend Authentic Detailing for anyone looking to give their car a top-notch makeover. Thank you, Dan and crew, for the outstanding work! ---

reviews.author: The Groovement_
reviews.text: Man, I met one of the AD family members at a Tesla charging station. He was very knowledgeable and helpful with the information for my car. I called the shop and with their additional knowledge and understanding, I went ahead and got my car tinted. They made me feel at home. Checking on me every hour it felt like. Amazing team I will be back again.

reviews.author: Merv Bunch
reviews.text: Listen, If you want things done right this is the place to go. Absolute detail. Does a great job and they make you feel good when you come in.

reviews.author: adamog45
reviews.text: Awesome Awesome Detailing Shop. Dan and crew were Fantastic. Took the time to explain every step of the process. Transformed my High Country with Hundreds and hundreds of water spots into a Brand New Truck Showroom Condition. Pleasure.

reviews.author: Barry Pate
reviews.text: Had an appointment at 1:00. Got there about 12:45 and they took my car as soon as I got there. Did a great job on my windows. Would highly recommend this company. Thanks.

reviews.author: Eric Rabuse
reviews.text: This shop is a fantastic find! Scheduling was easy, pricing was clear, and the whole process was smooth. My tint looks perfect and hit my goal of having a cooler car this summer. These guys just get it. Their skill and professionalism really stand out. Friendly staff, clean shop, great results. Highly recommend if you want quality without the hassle!

reviews.author: John Kuritz
reviews.text: Simply no words can describe the quality that was put into my granddaughters Honda. We were well taken care of through out the whole process from window tinting to a high quality protective coating on her car. Dan and his team are first class!

reviews.author: Anthony Schoenleber
reviews.text: I was referred to Authentic Detailing for a ceramic coating and window tinting on my 2021 Ram Limited and it was nothing shy of an amazing job. Dan was very communicative and very informative with the whole process, even provided pictures throughout the job. I will certainly refer him and his crew for anyone’s car detailing needs. They're definitely a top notch detailing crew. Great Work!!!!

reviews.author: Megan Cowan
reviews.text: I just got my window tint done by these guys, they did an amazing job. They made 35% tint look nice on my car. A nice windshield banner, side windows and rear glass tint job. I’m impressed and I I’ll definitely get other work done to my car with them in the future!

reviews.author: Ariel Hernandez
reviews.text: This is the first time we had a car ceramic coated and it took some research and decided to check out Authentic Detailing. When we met Dan, he was very personable, professional and it was apparent that he takes great pride in his work, so we signed up right there and then to get the ceramic coating, glass coating and wheel coating. Suffice to say, Dan and his team did a phenomenal job! I can’t believe my 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse could look any better, but I was mistaken! Thank you, Dan, Dominic and Team, for a job well done!

reviews.author: Jenn Brooks
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing did a fantastic job ceramic coating my 2022 Mustang! Their attention to detail has my car looking like glass! They also dipped my calipers! The company’s work is definitely top-notch!

reviews.author: Vick Thompson
reviews.text: I was warmly greeted, treated like a customer . The staff was very friendly , polite . They answered all my questions. My appointment was on time . The work was efficient, finished in a timely manner . I am so pleased and will recommend this business for all tinting needs .

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.text: They did a great job tinting the windows on my car. Nice and big waiting area with free WiFi and refreshments. Prices are great here, wish I herd of this place sooner.

reviews.author: Nick Carter
reviews.text: They did a great job on my 2022 Mustang. They did a ceramic coat and tinting. Above and beyond. Ceramic coated the rims as well. Also fixed scratches that came straight from the dealership! Would highly recommend and will use Authentic Detailing again in the future!

reviews.author: Marcelle Lee
reviews.text: Excellent detail and tint work on my wife’s 2021 Jaguar F Pace. These guys are very good and knowledgeable about their craft. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: De'Shawn Ballard
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed the class at the shop. Any expectation you have will be met and some. They provide you with all the essential tools and knowledge you need to feel confident tinting in the real world. The knowledge is easy to understand and explained in depth ensuring your success outside of the class. The environment is relaxed, but very intentional, thus relieving any stress you have about learning a new skill. I recommend this class to anybody and everybody looking to learn the skill of tinting.

reviews.author: Breanna Beasley
reviews.text: I gifted this detailing service, and it completely exceeded my expectations. It was in need of a thorough cleaning, both inside and out, and I didn't fully realize how much work it needed until the team at Authentic Detailing walked me through it. Now, the truck looks like it just rolled off the showroom floor! I couldn't recommend their services enough and will definitely be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Molly Thompson
reviews.text: Wow! 10/10. Took my X5 M to be detailed, tinted and ceramic-coated inside and out. I don’t believe I’ve ever dealt with a better car service company. The showroom is fantastic and demonstrates all of the product capabilities. The entire Authentic Detailing staff are professional, detail-oriented, timely and take great pride in their work. The owner actually rearranged a doctor’s appointment so he could be there to see my reaction to the finished product. The car is absolutely flawless inside and out. Prices were fair, and I would highly recommend them to anyone in the Triangle area. These guys are next-level!

reviews.author: Ray Gravis
reviews.text: Super nice place to get window tinting done. The staff is very friendly and professional, and the work they did on our vehicle was great! The waiting area and show room is super clean and tidy. Only minor complaint I have is that they did not inform me that there was a 3% credit card usage fee. I would have probably used another method of payment if I had been informed of this. But otherwise it was a very pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Tom Fulton
reviews.text: Just outstanding customer service, attention to detail, and work. Very pleased with the paint correction and ceramic coating they did. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sherif Fouad
reviews.text: This is a competitive space- it hard to decide who to trust your car with. The difference between a good detail shop and a great one is whether they actually pay attention to do DETAILS or just move you through fast to get on to the next one. I got my 23' 3rd gen Ford Raptor Wrapped here. Along w tint and ceramic coating. Awesome work, the level of detail is worth the price. I wanted matte black- his colleague Dave said satin is better, it looks classier but still has the non gloss that Im after. I see what he means now. Def the right move. The shop itself is professionally kept down to the detail as well. Dan was very communicative along the way. Dan also registered his work w my carfax so I didn't have to. Thank you guys

reviews.author: Alex anderson
reviews.text: This is my second time coming to this place ! The attention to detail seems to get better each time ! They explained everything very well and had a messy clean up done within a reasonable time ! Will be returning for all my bikes and vehicles !

reviews.author: Bryan Daniels
reviews.text: The service provided was excellent, efficiency and professional. The quality of the product was high, and it was offered at a good price.

reviews.author: Barrett Black
reviews.text: Dom was super attentive to details in every way and service was excellent. Very timely and professional would highly recommend to anyone looking for quality window tinting. Thanks!

reviews.author: Cristian Garcia
reviews.text: I took my fiance's car into Authentic Detailing to have it detailed and went ahead and got the windows tinted as a surprise for her. They did a fantastic job inside and out and the car feels new to her again. Especially getting rid of the slobber from our 145lb great pyrenees that she sometimes totes around. The tint looks great and the owner Dan told us that if we went with the 35% tint I had originally chosen the car wouldn't pass a tint meter inspection since the windows already have some green UV shading to them. So he recommended going with 40% and it honestly looks the same as 35% and it keeps the hassle off my fiance. I will definitely be bringing my other vehicles here in the future!

reviews.author: Nils Schultz
reviews.text: Words Cannot express what this Photographs do, Dan has been so professional with how he caters the delivery of his service that I just had to leave another car with him today! my 2014 Honda Crv looks brand this new and his prices are so reasonable 10+ stars plus. Authentic Detailing will be my to go place for my car needs and everyone I can refer to as well! Thank you so much Authentic Detailing!!

reviews.author: Dell J
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing were professional and informative at every point of the process. The finish product of my window tinting was excellent and I will recommend them to anyone interested.

reviews.author: Michael Mathers
reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding! They tinted my granddaughter's car windows and my house windows. Dan was professional and friendly.

reviews.author: Kylee Syra
reviews.text: We took our truck there to be detailed and they did a fantastic job. There was quite a bit of dog hair in the backseat and they were able to get all of it cleaned out! We also had them do the tint and it turned out great as well!

reviews.author: Dawson O'Dell
reviews.text: Did a great job restoring my corvette’s paint to shine like it should! Got a full paint correction and ceramic coat, Dan does a great job educating the customer and returning a great product!

reviews.author: Brian Briska
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing did ceramic and paint correction on our 1978 Corvette indy Pace Car, my 2023 Corvette, and our 23 Audi it was not the first time I ceramic my autos he blows the other guy away. job is phenomenal. Highly recommend Dan.

reviews.author: Brian Carter
reviews.text: The short of it is, this is a top-shelf business doing top-shelf work. I am very picky about trusting my vehicles to anyone. Authentic Detailing has more than earned my trust. My 2023 Tundra TRD Pro looks AMAZING. The coating and tint work they did took my new truck to the next level. Dan took the time to explain everything to me very patiently and never once tried to upsell me on something I didn’t need. If you are on the fence, my promise to you is that you will not regret how they will transform your vehicle. They have earned not only my trust but also any future business.

reviews.author: Darrin Schmitt
reviews.text: Dan and the team always go above and beyond. They have done everything from my car, motorcycle, boat and camper. And have done an excellent job on everything they touch. Doesn't matter if it just a weekly detail, Ceramic coat, Window or a full 3M protection package. The work is awesome and timely.

reviews.author: Jon Richardson
reviews.text: I brought my 2025 Lexus here to get the body ceramic coated… I was amazed by the showroom and the shop area as to how organized and clean it was! This just tells you how well your vehicle will come out once they are completed with it. I was very impressed with the quality and the car looks better than when I had bought it six months ago. They explained to me other options for protecting the vehicle, such as window tint, and other coatings that they had that I was not aware of, so I really appreciated that as well. . I will highly recommend them to all my friends and anyone else who is looking to get their car, detailed by a very high quality provider!

reviews.author: Andres Diaz
reviews.text: Dan and the crew at Authentic Detailing are the real deal ! They are true craftsmen in their trade especially when it comes to attention to detail I wouldn’t go anywhere else ! I have also attended their tint class I learned how to professionally tint car windows . The class is very informative and hands on so it’s worth the money

reviews.author: Elijah
reviews.text: Amazing detailing, Michelle did a wonderful job. The car looked better than when I purchased it. Thank you!

reviews.author: Antonio Rogers
reviews.text: Five stars all the way! Had them clean the interior of my Jeep, which was a total disaster thanks to my kids. They did an absolutely awesome job and went above and beyond. It looks amazing! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Art Watkins
reviews.text: Wonderful job and experience. Second vehicle for us and satisfied with both. These guys and girls are amazing! Give em a try!

reviews.author: Kelly Sutton
reviews.text: I wanted to take time out of my day to share with all my fellow car enthusiasts about my experience with Authentic Detailing located in Garner N.C. I'm the proud owner of a Audi RSQ8 black in color Dan and his crew of professional car detailers are nothing short of incredible TOP SHELF If you are looking for a place of business to get your car ceramic coated this is definitely the place to go I am more than pleased with their work and will now be a lifetime member for my car detailing needs.

reviews.author: Keith Davis
reviews.text: Authentic detailing did a great job tinting my 2025 RST they were timely, professional and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the results.

reviews.author: Austin Ellerbe
reviews.text: If you’re looking for top-tier automotive care, look no further than Authentic detailing. These guys are absolute pros, knowledgeable, honest, and passionate about what they do. From the moment I walked in, they made me feel like a priority, taking the time to explain everything and make sure I was completely comfortable with the process. Their attention to detail is unmatched, and the quality of their work speaks for itself. Whether it’s tint, PPF, or paint correction, these guys truly go above and beyond to deliver excellence. The shop runs like a well-oiled machine, and the results are always flawless. Huge thanks to these guys for their professionalism, craftsmanship, and next-level customer service.

reviews.author: Charles Bowman
reviews.text: Dan and his Team did an awesome job with my truck, and my wife and I were so impressed we dropped her vehicle off to get Ceramic coated and tint also! I highly recommend this place for installing your PPF, Ceramic coatings, and ceramic tint. The whole process and upfront pricing was refreshing and easy to understand. The shop in Garner is World Class and my wife and I were very impressed. Great Job AD Team!!!

reviews.author: eric svenson
reviews.text: Can’t recommend this place enough! The cleanest shop I have ever been in. Everyone is super professional , they explain everything well, and really take pride in their work. If you are looking to have your car protected and looking it’s absolute best, this is the place to go.

reviews.author: Mark Somerville
reviews.text: Everything I have to say and may not say in this post is excellent about Dan and his team. Professional, friendly, great customer service, and the work they put in and deliver is top notch. Wish I found them sooner.

reviews.author: C. Holmes
reviews.text: Fantastic service from Authentic Detailing! Not only did they quote a fair price for windshield protection and window tinting, but they were able to fit me in next day. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: G. Candels
reviews.text: Ceramic Tint turned our great and they had an awesome military discount. The heat deflection absolutely makes a difference

reviews.author: Michelle Cintrón
reviews.text: I went through the window tint training and I can confidently say it was a great experience. Dom and Dan are very knowledgeable and were thorough with the procedures. Tools were provided and the shop was comfortable and clean. Great team work.

reviews.author: Millennial Mike
reviews.text: Thank you so much for getting my car right after some cheap brand tire shine destroyed my paint. Gives such clarity and handled with great care. My 23 challenger is back to how I wanted it thanks to you guys. Will return for sure for future work

reviews.author: Bryanna Harris
reviews.text: Michelle and Dom took amazing care of my car! We walked through all the problem areas together, and they got right to work. When I saw my car, it was spotless, inside and out. They even detailed the exterior at no extra charge! Service like that definitely deserved a tip. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nichole SheisClothedinStrength
reviews.text: If I could give this company 20 stars, I would. From the first interaction over the phone was nothing but outstanding customer service. I was recommended and so happy I went along with my instinct to give Dan and his team a call. From the moment I Walked through the The door there was a sense of tranquility and peace. This beautiful location is immaculate, organized, clean, and full of smiles from the staff. Dan was extremely knowledgeable about the attention to detail and Products that I needed for tenting with my new vehicle. He was extremely informative throughout the process, very thoughtful, considerate and caring of the customers needs. My tenting experience and my car looks amazing. Authentic Detailing will now be my New Detailing family. I’ve already Scheduled for a full detail. Thank you, Dan and Team you exceeded my expectations. I wish your business continued success and will certainly tell all of my friends and family About my Authentic Detailing experience. AMAZING OUTSTANDING KUDOS More updates to come.

reviews.author: Andy Miller
reviews.text: Had them detail and do ceramic coating. Fantastic work, fast service and a very fair price! What else can I say!? I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Christian Grossetti
reviews.text: Very thankful for Dan’s helpfulness and willingness to make sure I was taken care of. I took his window tint training class and he made sure to accommodate my schedule and equip me with all the information I needed to become successful. Would definitely recommend his quality and customer service.

reviews.author: Rheia Spruill
reviews.text: I loved the way my car turned out! I had a great experience with Authentic Detailing. They were so nice and informative on the types of tint. I would 100% recommend anyone looking to get their windows tinted to come here!!

reviews.author: Kuntaa Martinez
reviews.text: Customer service is amazing Pricing is affordable The owner is a very understanding person. Shoutout to him and the crew for getting me right

reviews.author: Jose A. Gomez
reviews.text: Excellent customer service. Clean facilities. Friendly staff. Ease in making appointment. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cody
reviews.text: I visited today for their Premium Detail service. It was super easy with online scheduling via email and their shop / waiting area is clean and well maintained. It took about 2 hours for them to complete the service. My car has never looked better and I plan to return in the near future to have ceramic coating applied. Hats off to Dan and his staff for 5 Star Service!

reviews.author: Gwen Burley
reviews.text: Everything about Aithentic Detailing is amazing. I initially made an appointment for window tint on my Acura MDX. The online scheduling was a smooth, easy process and the tint work turned out great. We were so impressed with the communication, ease of the appointment, etc. that we had them complete ceramic coating on my Camaro ZL1. They did a phenomenal job on my car! They are knowledgeable, friendly, and take time to thoroughly understand what the customer wants. I met everyone that worked on my car, and the entire team is top- tier. My go-to shop now!

reviews.author: E Hill
reviews.text: Amazing work! It had been a long time since the car had received any attention. They did a great job getting it look like new again. 01Aug25 / Repeat business! We brought another vehicle to Authentic Detailing this week. A family member with disabilities had an accident in the car and we needed the front seats cleaned and odors removed. We are thrilled with the results! Upholstery is clean, dry and fresh. The whole car smells fresh and clean. Of course, they did super job with the rest of the detailing as well. The car shines and brings back that original pride in ownership.

reviews.author: Edward Crews
reviews.text: Great service, very professional. Will be coming back with my wife Mercedes for detail and window tint.

reviews.author: Sarah Ellerbe
reviews.text: I had a great experience from the first phone call to picking up my finished vehicle. And oh my, the shine!! I am thrilled with the workmanship and the way my truck looks. Can't say enough good things about this business and the service it provides.

reviews.author: Dwan Hanshaw
reviews.text: I needed my Cadillac tinted. Did a great job on all my windows. Recommend using Dan with Authentic Detailing.

reviews.author: Dee Earl
reviews.text: Those guys are great. They squeeze me on a short notice and did an awesome job. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Tyler Hageman
reviews.text: I would 100% recommend Authentic Detailing! They did a fantastic job making my pickup look new again. I would also highly recommend them for windows tint. I will definitely be going back!

reviews.author: Joco Bagels
reviews.text: Dan did three cars for me now amazing work . Love ceramic coating my cars look great , very affordable well worth it highly recommend

reviews.author: Lisa Marie
reviews.text: You guys did an amazing job. My car is so shiny. The ceramic coating is great and the tint looks great as well. Thank you for everything.

reviews.author: Paris Brasier
reviews.text: I brought in my 2021 Tacoma for a simple tint job and I had the best experience. Plus the snacks while I waited were the cherry on top. Reasonably Priced and I was even able to bring my truck back when I accidentally messed the tint up within the first week. Very accommodating, I will definitely be returning to explore the other services they provide.

reviews.author: Pancham k
reviews.text: I just got my car tented and when I tell you it’s beautiful, it’s beautiful. It makes the Mercedes look so amazing . From the professionalism, to the place being so clean I was impressed . I will recommend them to anyone who wants a great quality service .

reviews.author: Jonny Q
reviews.text: AD was great! Fast and very affordable. Highly recommend them. Dan was super helpful with picking out a tint. Will use them in the future

reviews.author: Chauncey Hatcher
reviews.text: The staff was so professional and attentive to my needs and made sure I knew all of the various options available to me. I’d recommend spending your time and money with these guys. Even the lobby is designed for interaction and convenience. And the tint looks great!

reviews.author: Jesse Lama
reviews.text: Just had my second vehicle tinted here. Dan and his team are great. The work is professional and clean. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Daniel Estrada
reviews.text: Everything about this shop is 100% professional. The people, materials, the waiting area, restroom, etc. They started a few minutes before the appointment timeslot and finished much faster than their ETA. Fair pricing and good workmanship. I highly recommend Authentic Detailing.

reviews.author: robert lafromboise
reviews.text: This is my third vehicle Authentic Detailing has done for me, each time ceramic coatings have lasted. Smooth to the touch (like glass look). Can'task for more yet I did. They put tint on this car and wow it makes a difference with the heat coming through not to mention it looks amazing. Great job would and do recommend.

reviews.author: Ed Hill
reviews.text: Dan was great! Got me in and out quickly and did an excellent job. The window tint on my car looks fantastic.

reviews.author: Tonio Da Quiet Storm
reviews.text: They did an outstanding job on my car. I had removed racing stripes off a 2020 Dodge Charger Scat Pack as it was still looking like the stripes were still on with the residue left behind, but these guys made it look so amazing. The paint looks so good that it has the showroom shine. Thank you, guys, as I would definitely recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Kelley Ewing
reviews.text: Very pleased with the way my son’s car turned out. It needed quite a bit of help. They met our expectations and beyond. They did an awesome job. I Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Amber Bell
reviews.text: Found a brochure after visiting Carolina Quick Lube! Made the appointment online. Brought in same day. It’s like having a brand new car all over again! Thanks so much, will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Stephanie Mathis
reviews.text: I had a great experience at Authentic Detailing and would highly recommend. I'm so glad I found them and will continue to use their services in the future. I got my vehicle's interior detailed, and it looks incredible! They were fast and super kind and courteous. Their waiting room is clean and comfortable. 5 stars hands down.

reviews.author: Evan Uhler
reviews.text: We dropped our Honda Odyssey off for a full detail, mainly focused on the interior. We have two young kids so you can only imagine what the interior looked like. Dan and his team knocked it out of the park with their attention to detail, the interior looked brand new. I didn't expect such a drastic transformation! The entire vehicle looked amazing inside and out. We also got the front windows ceramic tinted while it was there, which really seems to help with the blocking the sun. Highly Recommend Authentic Detailing, we'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: D.J. Venne Jr
reviews.text: Great family run business! Had a solid experience from initial walk in to completion of service. Had a new windshield installed with protective covering and front windows tinted. Very knowledgeable and professional. If you’re looking for any glass needs or detailing specifically you can’t go wrong with these guys.

reviews.author: Jackie Mullins
reviews.text: Dan was very professional, knowledgeable, and patient with me during the entire process of getting my car windows tinted. He listened for the details that mattered to me and made those details his priority. The lobby is clean with a mix of seating, and free wifi if you need it for work. The window tinting turned out great and I’m very pleased. Highly recommend Authentic Detailing!

reviews.author: Ali Eaton
reviews.text: Wonderful service, the new tint on my car looks great! Would definitely recommend. Staff were very helpful and willing to answer all questions. Appointment started on time, waiting room had good amenities.

reviews.author: Tesha McMillon
reviews.text: This was a great experience! The staff was friendly, hospitable, and accommodating. I love the setup inside. I was able to work on my laptop while I waited on one of the workstations they had. The tint job was also great. I would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: Ryan Podesta
reviews.text: I went to Authentic Detailing for a window tint job for my Tesla Model 3. They have a professional staff, quick turnaround, and great installation work. I would recommend them to anyone in the area.

reviews.author: C Littmann
reviews.text: Dan not only did a fabulous job on my window tinting, he walked me through every detail of the process and made me feel comfortable with the service being done. I had the original window tint from the dealership removed and replaced. With my car being a 2011, it was a tricky removal process with the age of and sun damage to the original tint. The outcome was beautiful! Definitely recommend and will be having more work completed to both our vehicles !

reviews.author: Iris Abrams
reviews.text: Great detail and coating.. car looks new. Entire staff is lovely and accommodating. So happy to meet them. I will continue maintaining the cars detailing needs there!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: I met with Dan (Owner) and he was extremely knowledgeable and professional. I scheduled an appointment for my 1970 Chevelle (100% restored) and he and his staff were on time and performed an incredible job on my Chevelle. If you are looking for a one stop place with a highly qualified team for any and all servi es on your vehicles, don't look any further. I would recommend Dan and Authentic Detailing to my friends, clients, and family. Well done!!

reviews.author: Briana Hicks
reviews.text: I took my Nissan today to get it detailed and washed and they did a really good job. I appreciate them going above and beyond in making sure my car was taken care of. I will definitely recommend this place to my family and friends :))

reviews.author: William Bartholomew
reviews.text: Car was ceramic coated and windows tinted. It was done quick and came out nice. 10/10, would tint again.

reviews.author: NC Motorsports
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing have been doing all of our recondition on the vehicles we sell. Always amazing work no matter the job we give them.

reviews.author: Ein
reviews.text: Both the guys I’ve talked to there have always been really nice and helpful. Got me in quick and did really great work. So happy with how my car turned out!

reviews.author: Bobby Brown
reviews.text: Dan and family are absolutely fantastic. Love taking the cars in to get cleaned up, especially for car shows.

reviews.author: George The Ups Driver
reviews.text: They did a nice job on my tint, had my car tinted in 35 all around, and a sun strip. Only issue I had was there was still water on the dash, and there was water stains all over my interior from where the water dried. Would've been 5 stars if they wiped everything down before giving me back my vehicle.

reviews.author: Ingrid Blount
reviews.text: I received tint service for my Lincoln MKZ. She was pretty when she went in but when she came out... "All eyes was on her and she was a showstopper!" The staff and owner are very knowledgeable and personable. Prices are reasonable too. If you need a personal touch for your auto detailing, plus more, they are it!

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.text: Dan did a phenomenal job ceramic coating this beauty. I will be bringing the truck by next. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Shauna Sallinger
reviews.text: Dan and his team did an incredible job detailing my car! It looks brand new and I will definitely be going back in the future and recommending them to everyone! Thank you Authentic Detailing!

reviews.author: Andrew Womble
reviews.text: Stopped by to get my Silverado cleaned up before thanksgiving. Dan (owner) was patient enough to wait for me and even stayed after hours to give my truck a thorough cleaning!! 10/10 recommend. Will return soon.

reviews.author: Judith Cerna
reviews.text: would recommend to anyone!! same day service, very flexible & they have a very understanding & friendly staff. Went above and beyond! Would come back and bring my other vehicles to them!!

reviews.author: Jennifer Holder
reviews.text: The tint on my rear window had started bubbling. It was a difficult to remove because the adhesive had separated from the film. It took a while and a few tricks but they cleanly removed the old tint and put new film on. It looks great!

reviews.author: Brian Thomas
reviews.text: Visited Dan and his crew at Authentic Detailing today and had my windows tinted. Looks amazing. Very happy with the job they did and would highly recommend them to others.

reviews.author: William Meadows
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing does a great job every time! They are very thorough and our cars look brand new when we pick them up! I’d highly recommend them.

reviews.author: John Fleming
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing did an awesome job tinting my front 2 windows on my Silverado for a reasonable price. My truck looks great and I will definitely be taking my wife's car to have it done. Thanks Authentic Detailing for doing an amazing job!

reviews.author: Mashieka Lee
reviews.text: Great job detailing my Jaguar, customer service was outstanding! Would definitely recommend coming out.

reviews.author: Paul Nelson
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing did a fantastic job for us! They are a locally owned, family-run company with fair prices, and run a very professional operation.

reviews.author: Traylor Towing
reviews.text: Authentic Detailing NC did such an AMAZING job on my vehicle. It looks brand new! The inside AND outside are absolutely spotless! They have awesome customer service also. I will highly recommend them to EVERYONE I know.

reviews.author: Brianne Garrison
reviews.text: Mike and Dom came out to clean my employers car. They were so kind and efficient. They did such a good job and they came to the house which was so convenient! I will definitely recommend and use in the future.

reviews.author: Max Jeffers
reviews.text: Dan took care of me and my Vehicle. I really have nothing but respect and appreciation for the quality of work they do at Authentic Detailing. No complaints at all, looking forward to utilizing this service in the future. Thank you again Dan! I appreciate it!

reviews.author: Ken T
reviews.text: If you are remotely considering getting your vehicle Detailed, Ceramic Clear-Coated, Wrapped or Tinted, go see Dan! Great location, clean facility, quick service and professional staff at a great price!

reviews.author: Kristian V
reviews.text: Fantastic service. Super professional and they were even able to fit me in at the last minute. The detailing was top notch - I will definitely bring my vehicles here for detailing and other services.

reviews.author: Rick Shipp
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things. They took the appearance of my ride next level. I told them what I wanted and they not only delivered, but when above and beyond. I will certainly be using AD for all my vehicles.

reviews.author: Malia Hall
reviews.text: If you need a clean car this is the place to go! Super clean shop and waiting area. I loved that the owner walked out with me to make sure I was satisfied with the job! Excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Marley Ranew
reviews.text: Great customer service!! Easy to schedule, super friendly and I was in and out in less than an hour the day of my apt!! My windows look fantastic!

reviews.author: Matthew Gorman
reviews.text: Thanks for cleaning my vehicle for me! We were on our way out the door for a busy weekend and it really helped having a local, trusted, mobile detailer pull in with their own electricity, their own water, and never even needed anything from me. Car is spotless and price is well worth it. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Dominique Alexander
reviews.text: Very Great class!! I would recommend anyone that wants to learn or get a service definitely come here!!

reviews.author: Chad Walker
reviews.text: Needed my son's cars tint removed before the inspection was due. With it being a Saturday, I did a Google search to see if anyone around me was open on a Saturday. Authentic Detailing came up and after see other services they provide, I will certainly be keeping them in mind!!

reviews.author: Brian Shatswell
reviews.text: Dan completed a sun tint strip on my Silverado. He completed the work very fast and was really good to work with. I will be back for future tint, ceramic coating needs. 5 stars!

reviews.author: Bri
reviews.text: The only people I’ll let touch my car! They are incredible - excited for them to do my tint as well. If you’re looking at reviews here, stop right now and book a service!

reviews.author: Michelle Horne
reviews.text: My husband and I are very pleased with the outcome of our car. Price was very good. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Keith Levasseur
reviews.text: Friendly staff and they did an amazing job with the window tint! This is the second time I had them do one of my vehicles and once again did a great job.

reviews.author: Daniel Schad
reviews.text: Dan at Authentic Detailing did an amazing job. His knowledge of the products and the process is impressive, but the results are better. Very meticulous and ready exactly when it was supposed to be done. Thank you Dan!

reviews.author: Beth Wandland
reviews.text: These guys do an amazing job. Super happy with the coating and the tint work they did and every time I take it to get it detailed it just shines.

reviews.author: CJ morgan
reviews.text: Can’t recommend these guys enough! Dan & Dom both are class acts, with high awareness, attention to detail & outstanding customer service. Great group of guys!

reviews.author: Anthony Nowak
reviews.text: Job was done quicker than estimated, car looks great. Didn’t think they’d be able to save the paint, but it looks as good as new!

reviews.author: Amber Guthiel
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing detail. The amount of cheerios and milk that was in the car, I can’t believe they got it clean as If it’s a brand new car off the lot. Thank you so much. Can’t recommend them more!!

reviews.author: michael musa
reviews.text: Good experience. My car looks super clean. Thanks guys for a great wash. This is definitely a good experience.

reviews.author: Frank Panna
reviews.text: Had tint added to front windows of new car. Came out great! Very knowledgeable, well priced, quick and quality work. Thanks!

reviews.author: Tracey Peedin Jones
reviews.text: Service was professional and quick! They are extremely knowledgeable about their products and were able to help make the best decisions for your needs.

reviews.author: Tony Scordia
reviews.text: Thanks Dan. Great job. Fast friendly and great prices. I would recommend to anyone. I will be back for interior and exterior detailing.

reviews.author: Kimberly S.
reviews.text: This shop took great care of my car. Tinted my windows and did a deep clean. Im very happy with the results.

reviews.author: Mia Jones
reviews.text: AD did a remarkable job on my car they tinted my windows and I would recommend them to anyone that needs their windows tinted.

reviews.author: J. Adams
reviews.text: I had a really good experience at this shop. The guys were friendly and answered all of my questions. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Luke Smith
reviews.text: Very happy with the process and product that they have to offer!! Explained about all the process steps also all the different types of tint. Very happy with the truck!!

reviews.author: Matthew Corts
reviews.text: Best Tint and detailing available in the triangle !!!! All pricing is fair and straightforward especially for the top quality work offered here

reviews.author: Gary Grammer
reviews.text: Very professional and extremely informative. Appreciate time and information about all my questions. Also very, very affordable.

reviews.author: bcarerros “Inviolable”
reviews.text: Shout out to the Tesla Divas who recommended this place to me. They did a great job, quick and great prices!!
